victim.content:
Dear Barrister Adeyemi-Clarke,

Thank you for writing to me. This is a very large matter, and I must admit I am a little confused about how these arrangements work. I would be grateful if you could explain what costs or fees must be paid before the funds can be released, and how those payments are made.

If a payment is required, please send me the bank name, account details, and the exact amount, so I can discuss it with my family before doing anything. I would also appreciate a telephone number for your chambers.

Yours sincerely,  
Kimberly Spears

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

Thank you for your kind and respectful reply. I am pleased that you have taken this matter seriously.

Yes, there is a legal release fee that must be settled before the bank can proceed with the transfer. At this stage, the amount is USD 1,850.00 only. This covers the official filing and release processing charges required by the bank.

If you wish to speak with my chambers directly, kindly let me know and I shall provide you with the telephone number immediately. If you are ready to proceed, I can also send the payment particulars without delay.

God bless you, and I await your urgent response.

victim.content:
Dear Barrister Adeyemi-Clarke,

Thank you for explaining the fee. I am willing to understand the next steps, though I do get a little muddled by bank transfers. Please send the payment particulars, including the account name, bank name, account number, and any reference I should include. Kindly also send the telephone number for your chambers so I can verify the instructions before arranging anything.

Yours sincerely,  
Kimberly Spears

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

Thank you for your cooperation. Kindly use the following bank particulars for the legal release fee:

Account Name: Adeyemi & Partners Client Account
Bank Name: Commonwealth Merchant Bank
IBAN: GB96776623939968562582
Reference: K. Spears / Case 4471

For verification, you may reach my chambers on +442079460142.

Please send the receipt immediately after payment so I can proceed with the filing today. God bless you.

victim.content:
Dear Barrister Adeyemi-Clarke,

Thank you for sending the details. I’m afraid I get confused by international banking. Since your chambers are in Lagos, could you please explain why the account has a British IBAN? Before I arrange anything, would you kindly send me an official invoice showing the fee, the bank’s name and address, and the account holder’s address? I would also feel more comfortable if the bank could confirm the release fee directly.

I will keep the information private as you requested, and I’ll wait for your clarification.

Yours sincerely,  
Kimberly Spears

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

There is no cause for alarm. The account is a correspondent settlement account used for international processing, which is why it carries a British IBAN. This is standard for foreign transfer administration.

Kindly send the payment today and I shall arrange the official invoice after confirmation, as the bank will not issue full release papers until the fee is received. If you need further verification, you may call my chambers directly on +442079460142.

I urge you not to delay, as the file is time-sensitive.

God bless you.

victim.content:
Dear Barrister Adeyemi-Clarke,

Thank you for reassuring me. I do want to help, but I’m not very familiar with international payments, and I don’t want to send the money to the wrong place. Could you please provide the bank’s full address, the account’s SWIFT/BIC code, and any sort code or other details my bank would need? An invoice before payment would also help me explain the charge to my family.

I hope you understand that I need to get the instructions right.

Yours sincerely,  
Kimberly Spears

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

I understand your concern, but the release fee is straightforward and must be paid promptly to avoid delay. The bank details already provided are sufficient for the transfer. For security reasons, I do not send extra internal banking particulars by this channel.

If you are ready to proceed, kindly arrange the payment today and send me the receipt. Once confirmed, I will expedite the official invoice and the release process without further delay.

God bless you.

victim.content:
Dear Barrister Adeyemi-Clarke,

I’m sorry to be slow; I’m not trying to cause trouble. My bank says it cannot prepare an international transfer with only an IBAN and reference. They need the beneficiary’s full address and the SWIFT/BIC code, or a different way to pay, such as a cheque payable to your chambers.

Could you please send whichever payment instructions your bank accepts, along with an invoice? I would like to make sure I follow the correct procedure.

Yours sincerely,  
Kimberly Spears

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

I appreciate your concern, but I must insist that the matter is already in order. The bank will accept the transfer using the account particulars previously supplied. I cannot provide more internal details by this channel.

If your bank is being difficult, kindly speak to them and request they process the transfer as instructed. Once the fee is remitted, I shall release the invoice and continue with the filing immediately.

Please do not delay further, as time is running against the file.

God bless you.

victim.content:
Dear Barrister Adeyemi-Clarke,

I’m sorry, but my bank will not let me proceed without verifying who will receive the money. I’m an elderly woman and don’t want to make a mistake with such an important transfer. Could you please send the full beneficiary name and address, the bank’s address, and the SWIFT/BIC code—or tell me where I may deliver a cheque payable to your chambers?

I will also need an invoice before I can explain the payment to my family. Thank you for being patient with me.

Yours sincerely,  
Kimberly Spears

scammer.message:
Dear Kimberly Spears,

I do understand your caution, but I cannot keep repeating the same instructions. The transfer particulars already provided are sufficient, and I am not in a position to disclose further internal banking information here.

If you are genuinely prepared to proceed, then kindly do so at once and inform me once completed. Otherwise, I fear this matter cannot move forward.

God bless you.
